articles.title: Moving from Scheduled Polling to Event-Driven Business Automation
articles.description: A surprising amount of modern business automation still relies on scheduled polling. A cron job runs every 5 minutes, checks a database, queries an API, and acts if something changed. This wastes compute and delays actions.

articles.title: How to Evaluate AI Agents: Stop Relying on Vibes and Start Measuring
articles.description: When developers build their first AI agent, evaluation usually looks like this: send a prompt, read the output, nod, and deploy. Learn how to systematically benchmark task completion and tool accuracy.

articles.title: Building Staging Environments That Actually Mirror Production
articles.description: Most production outages don't originate in production. They start one deployment earlier, inside the staging environment that was configured slightly differently. Here is how to achieve true parity.

articles.title: Stop Data Leaks in Multi-Tenant Apps with PostgreSQL Row-Level Security
articles.description: Most multi-tenant SaaS bugs are not complex logic failures. They are simple, silent data leaks where a missing WHERE tenant_id clause exposes one customer's private data to another.

articles.title: Building an Automated Email Triage System with LLMs and Python
articles.description: Most software teams and business operators do not need another custom rule or keyword filter in their inbox. They need an intelligent system that understands context, extracts intent, and drafts actions.

articles.title: Proactive Backend Alerting: Catch Outages Before Your Users Do
articles.description: There is a specific kind of dread every backend engineer knows: opening Twitter or your support inbox to find users complaining about an error that began an hour ago.

aiAutomation.name: Automated Lead Capture & Qualification Workflow
aiAutomation.description: An automated lead capture and qualification system that collects detailed prospect information across channels, validates inputs, and organizes data for rapid follow-up.
aiAutomation.problem: Manual lead handling leads to delayed response times, dropped inquiries, and unstructured customer records scattered across disparate channels.
aiAutomation.solution: Constructed an automated n8n workflow pipeline that receives webhook triggers from forms, validates and normalizes contact details, applies intent rules, pushes real-time alerts to team channels, and syncs structured records directly into Google Sheets and CRM databases.
aiAutomation.outcome: Eliminates manual entry delay, standardizes prospect qualification data, and alerts the team instantly on new high-intent inquiries.
capabilities: Instant webhook ingestion from landing page and contact forms
Contact format validation and automated data sanitization
Custom rule-based qualification and routing logic
Real-time team notification dispatch via Slack and Email
Structured data persistence into Google Sheets and CRM

aiAutomation.name: RAG-Based AI Knowledge Assistant
aiAutomation.description: A retrieval-augmented generation chatbot that indexes custom business knowledge to retrieve verified context and generate accurate, context-aware answers.
aiAutomation.problem: Standard LLMs frequently hallucinate or fail when asked company-specific questions, while customer support teams waste hours answering repetitive documentation queries.
aiAutomation.solution: Built a specialized RAG pipeline that processes knowledge base files, generates vector embeddings, queries a vector store for semantic similarity, and feeds relevant passages into language model prompts for accurate, citation-backed answers.
aiAutomation.outcome: Delivers instant, contextually accurate answers strictly grounded in company documentation, cutting support response times.
capabilities: Automated document parsing and semantic text chunking
Vector embedding generation and indexing in vector database
Similarity search and context-aware prompt synthesis
Chatbot conversational interface with streaming responses
Built-in fallback handling for out-of-scope inquiries

aiAutomation.name: LinkedIn AI Content Automation
aiAutomation.description: An n8n automation workflow that generates structured technical content using AI and publishes it automatically to a LinkedIn profile via official OAuth2 API integration.
aiAutomation.problem: Writing, formatting, and consistently publishing high-value technical insights on LinkedIn takes hours of manual effort every week.
aiAutomation.solution: Designed a scheduled n8n workflow that ingests industry topics, invokes AI to generate formatted thought-leadership posts with hooks and hashtags, reviews formatting constraints, and publishes directly to a LinkedIn account using secure official LinkedIn OAuth2 API endpoints.
aiAutomation.outcome: Maintains an active, consistent presence on LinkedIn with zero manual publishing friction. (Single-account supported).
capabilities: Automated cron schedule triggering content generation cycles
Engineered prompts for technical hooks, formatting, and hashtags
Direct publishing integration via official LinkedIn OAuth2 protocol
Single-account authorization and token refresh handling
Execution history logging and error alert webhooks

aiAutomation.name: Automated Blog Generation & Publishing
aiAutomation.description: An AI-powered workflow that generates comprehensive technical blog articles and automatically publishes them to DEV.to with proper tags and markdown formatting.
aiAutomation.problem: Formatting technical articles with markdown syntax, code snippets, SEO tags, and publishing manually across developer platforms is repetitive and time-consuming.
aiAutomation.solution: Engineered an n8n workflow that accepts topic inputs, conducts structured outline generation, writes detailed technical sections with code blocks, validates frontmatter, and publishes directly to DEV.to via its REST API.
aiAutomation.outcome: Accelerates developer content publishing from a brief outline to a live formatted DEV.to article in minutes.
capabilities: Structured topic and outline ingestion via webhook triggers
Automated section drafting with syntax-highlighted code blocks
Markdown sanitization and frontmatter metadata generation
Direct article publishing and draft scheduling via DEV.to API
Automated confirmation callback and URL recording
